import hashlib, subprocess, json, pathlib
R="/private/tmp/claude-501/pr86-ci-live/lt/runs/sysspec105/fx"
P=R+"/plugins/system-spec-harness"
v=subprocess.run(["python3","-c","import pathlib;print('\\n'.join(str(p) for p in pathlib.Path('%s').rglob('validate-source-citation.py')))"%P],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.split()
print(v)
S=R+"/system-spec/spec-state.json"; F=R+"/system-spec/fetched-references.json"
for p in [S,F]+v: print(p, hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest())
argv=["python3",v[0],"--targets",S,"--references",F,"--state",S,"--repo-root",R]
r=subprocess.run(argv,capture_output=True,text=True)
print(json.dumps({"argv":argv,"exit":r.returncode,"stdout":r.stdout,"stderr":r.stderr},ensure_ascii=False))
PY
